newsitem.title: CANADA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF KATJA SEIZINGER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF KATJA SEIZINGER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Katja Seizinger, who won the women's World Cup at Lake Louise Saturday:

Previous Cup victories (25): Downhill -- Montafon 1992; Morzine 1992, '93; Vail 1992, '94; Cortina 1993, '94; Veysonnaz 1993; Whistler 1994; St. Anton (I) 1995; Val d'Isere 1996; Giant Slalom -- Soelden 1996; Kloevjo 1993; Maribor (II) 1996; Lillehammer 1996; Super-G -- Santa Caterina 1992; Lake Louise 1992, '94; Are 1993; Cortina (I) 1994; Mammoth Mountain 1994; Bormio 1995; Garmisch 1996; Val d'Isere (I, II) 1996.

Other: A millionaire's daughter and the reigning Olympic downhill champion, she has donated some of her winnings to charity. A Kevin Costner fan, she has listed "Dances With Wolves" as her favourite movie.
